```{=html}
<style>
  @page {
    size: 8.5in 11in;
    margin: 0;
  }
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body {
    width: 8.5in;
    height: 11in;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: Georgia, serif;
    background: white;
    padding: 0 !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
  }
  main, .quarto-container, #quarto-content, #quarto-document-content {
    padding: 0 !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    max-width: none !important;
    width: 8.5in !important;
  }
  .page {
    position: relative;
    width: 7.5in;
    height: 10in;
    margin: 0.5in;
    background: white;
  }

  /* ---- Registration marks ---- */
  .reg { position: absolute; width: 0; height: 0; }
  .reg-tl { top: 0;    left: 0;  border-top:    28px solid black; border-right:  28px solid transparent; }
  .reg-tr { top: 0;    right: 0; border-top:    28px solid black; border-left:   28px solid transparent; }
  .reg-bl { bottom: 0; left: 0;  border-bottom: 28px solid black; border-right:  28px solid transparent; }
  .reg-br { bottom: 0; right: 0; border-bottom: 28px solid black; border-left:   28px solid transparent; }

  /* ---- Title & subtitle ---- */
  .title {
    position: absolute;
    top: 2%;
    left: 0; right: 0;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 26pt;
    font-weight: bold;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
  }
  .subtitle {
    position: absolute;
    top: 9%;
    left: 0; right: 0;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 10pt;
    color: #555;
    font-style: italic;
  }

  /*
    LAYOUT DESIGN
    =============
    Bubble columns (A/B/C/D) occupy the LEFT side of the safe-area.
    Question text occupies the RIGHT side.

    Bubble column centres (safe-area %, i.e. % of .page width 7.5in):
      A: 6%   (x1=2.8%,  x2=9.2%  → centre ~6%)
      B: 17%  (x1=13.8%, x2=20.2% → centre ~17%)
      C: 28%  (x1=24.8%, x2=31.2% → centre ~28%)
      D: 39%  (x1=35.8%, x2=42.2% → centre ~39%)

    Bubble width  = 6.4% of .page width  (≈ 0.48in on 7.5in)
    Bubble height = 6.6% of .page height (≈ 0.66in on 10in)

    Row centres (safe-area %, i.e. % of .page height 10in):
      Q1: 27%  (y1=23.7%, y2=30.3%)
      Q2: 41%  (y1=37.7%, y2=44.3%)
      Q3: 55%  (y1=51.7%, y2=58.3%)
      Q4: 69%  (y1=65.7%, y2=72.3%)
      Q5: 83%  (y1=79.7%, y2=86.3%)

    Question text block: left=46%, right=1%, top = row_centre - 6%

    Absolute page-fraction coords for quiz_functions.R:
      page_x  = 0.5/8.5 + safe_x_frac * (7.5/8.5)
      page_y  = 0.5/11  + safe_y_frac * (10/11)

    Col A  safe x1=2.8%  → page_x1 = 0.0588 + 0.028*0.8824  = 0.0835
           safe x2=9.2%  → page_x2 = 0.0588 + 0.092*0.8824  = 0.1400
    Col B  safe x1=13.8% → page_x1 = 0.0588 + 0.138*0.8824  = 0.1806
           safe x2=20.2% → page_x2 = 0.0588 + 0.202*0.8824  = 0.2370
    Col C  safe x1=24.8% → page_x1 = 0.0588 + 0.248*0.8824  = 0.2777
           safe x2=31.2% → page_x2 = 0.0588 + 0.312*0.8824  = 0.3341
    Col D  safe x1=35.8% → page_x1 = 0.0588 + 0.358*0.8824  = 0.3748
           safe x2=42.2% → page_x2 = 0.0588 + 0.422*0.8824  = 0.4312

    Q1 safe y1=23.7% → page_y1 = 0.0455 + 0.237*0.9091 = 0.2609
       safe y2=30.3% → page_y2 = 0.0455 + 0.303*0.9091 = 0.3209
    Q2 safe y1=37.7% → page_y1 = 0.0455 + 0.377*0.9091 = 0.3882
       safe y2=44.3% → page_y2 = 0.0455 + 0.443*0.9091 = 0.4482
    Q3 safe y1=51.7% → page_y1 = 0.0455 + 0.517*0.9091 = 0.5155
       safe y2=58.3% → page_y2 = 0.0455 + 0.583*0.9091 = 0.5755
    Q4 safe y1=65.7% → page_y1 = 0.0455 + 0.657*0.9091 = 0.6427
       safe y2=72.3% → page_y2 = 0.0455 + 0.723*0.9091 = 0.7027
    Q5 safe y1=79.7% → page_y1 = 0.0455 + 0.797*0.9091 = 0.7700
       safe y2=86.3% → page_y2 = 0.0455 + 0.863*0.9091 = 0.8300
  */

  /* ---- Column headers ---- */
  .col-header {
    position: absolute;
    top: 14%;
    width: 10%;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 9pt;
    font-weight: bold;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    color: #333;
  }
  .ch-1 { left: 6%; }
  .ch-2 { left: 17%; }
  .ch-3 { left: 28%; }
  .ch-4 { left: 39%; }

  /* ---- Dividers ---- */
  .divider {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0; right: 0;
    height: 1px;
    background: #ccc;
  }

  /* ---- Question text (RIGHT side, left=46%) ---- */
  .question {
    position: absolute;
    left: 46%;
    right: 1%;
    font-size: 8pt;
    color: #111;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  .q1 { top: 21%; }
  .q2 { top: 35%; }
  .q3 { top: 49%; }
  .q4 { top: 63%; }
  .q5 { top: 77%; }

  .q-num { font-weight: bold; font-size: 8.5pt; }

  .answers {
    margin-top: 3px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 18px 1fr;
    gap: 1px 4px;
    padding-left: 4px;
  }
  .ans-label { font-weight: bold; white-space: nowrap; }
  .ans-text   { color: #111; }

  /* ---- Bubbles ---- */
  .bubble {
    position: absolute;
    width:  6.40%;   /* 6.4% of 7.5in ≈ 0.48in */
    height: 6.60%;   /* 6.6% of 10in  ≈ 0.66in */
    border: 2.5px solid #222;
    border-radius: 5px;
    background: white;
  }

  /* Column A  (left=2.8%) */
  .b-a-q1 { left: 2.8%;  top: 23.7%; }
  .b-a-q2 { left: 2.8%;  top: 37.7%; }
  .b-a-q3 { left: 2.8%;  top: 51.7%; }
  .b-a-q4 { left: 2.8%;  top: 65.7%; }
  .b-a-q5 { left: 2.8%;  top: 79.7%; }

  /* Column B  (left=13.8%) */
  .b-b-q1 { left: 13.8%; top: 23.7%; }
  .b-b-q2 { left: 13.8%; top: 37.7%; }
  .b-b-q3 { left: 13.8%; top: 51.7%; }
  .b-b-q4 { left: 13.8%; top: 65.7%; }
  .b-b-q5 { left: 13.8%; top: 79.7%; }

  /* Column C  (left=24.8%) */
  .b-c-q1 { left: 24.8%; top: 23.7%; }
  .b-c-q2 { left: 24.8%; top: 37.7%; }
  .b-c-q3 { left: 24.8%; top: 51.7%; }
  .b-c-q4 { left: 24.8%; top: 65.7%; }
  .b-c-q5 { left: 24.8%; top: 79.7%; }

  /* Column D  (left=35.8%) */
  .b-d-q1 { left: 35.8%; top: 23.7%; }
  .b-d-q2 { left: 35.8%; top: 37.7%; }
  .b-d-q3 { left: 35.8%; top: 51.7%; }
  .b-d-q4 { left: 35.8%; top: 65.7%; }
  .b-d-q5 { left: 35.8%; top: 79.7%; }

  /* ---- Footer ---- */
  .footer {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0.5%;
    left: 0; right: 0;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 7.5pt;
    color: #aaa;
  }

  @media print {
    html, body { width: 8.5in; height: 11in; }
    #quarto-header, nav, .navbar, footer { display: none !important; }
  }
</style>
```
